chemistry-e5-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-e5-c.material: [Crystallization miri emi] E mere ngwọta saturated site n'ịgbaze alum n'ime mmiri ọkụ 60℃ ruo mgbe ọ gbazeghị ọzọ, wee kwụọ eri silk n'ime ya ma hapụ ya ka ọ dị jụụ nwayọ n'okpomọkụ ụlọ, kristal alum mara mma dị ka nkume dị oke ọnụ tolitere n'eri silk. chemistry-killer-05.title: Mgbe a na-etinye $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$
chemistry-killer-05.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-05.material:
Mgbe a na-etinye $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 0.1 M n'ime $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ 0.2 M 50 mL, a nyochara ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ions (mmol) n'ime ngwọta mmiri. A naghị agụ mmiri dị ka ions, ma naanị mmeghachi omume $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$ na-eme.
Olu NaOH(aq) agbakwunyere (mL): 0 / 50 / 100
Ngụkọta ions (mmol): 20 / 20 / 20
Mgbe agbakwunyere NaOH(aq) 150 mL, kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma ọnụọgụ $\mathrm{Na^+ : Cl^- : OH^-}$ n'ime ngwakọta ngwọta, na (ngụkọta ions mgbe a gwakọtara) ÷ (ngụkọta ions dị n'ime HCl(aq) 50 mL na NaOH(aq) 150 mL tupu a gwakọta), n'usoro? (Leghara anya n'onwe-ionization nke mmiri)
chemistry-killer-05.s.s1.prompt:
Mgbe a na-etinye $\mathrm{NaOH(aq)}$ 0.1 M n'ime $\mathrm{HCl(aq)}$ 0.2 M 50 mL, a nyochara ngụkọta ọnụọgụ ions (mmol) n'ime ngwọta mmiri. A naghị agụ mmiri dị ka ions, ma naanị mmeghachi omume $\mathrm{H^+ + OH^- \rightarrow H_2O}$ na-eme.
Olu NaOH(aq) agbakwunyere (mL): 0 / 50 / 100
Ngụkọta ions (mmol): 20 / 20 / 20
Mgbe agbakwunyere NaOH(aq) 150 mL, kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma ọnụọgụ $\mathrm{Na^+ : Cl^- : OH^-}$ n'ime ngwakọta ngwọta, na (ngụkọta ions mgbe a gwakọtara) ÷ (ngụkọta ions dị n'ime HCl(aq) 50 mL na NaOH(aq) 150 mL tupu a gwakọta), n'usoro? (Leghara anya n'onwe-ionization nke mmiri)
chemistry-killer-05.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ịkọwa tebụl. 0 mL: H+ 10 + Cl- 10 = 20. 50 mL: H+ 5, Cl- 10, Na+ 5 = 20. 100 mL: Cl- 10, Na+ 10 = 20 (ebe neutralization). Ruo ebe neutralization, Na+ na-anọchi H+ 1:1, ya mere ngụkọta ions na-adịgide.
Nzọụkwụ 2: 150 mL: NaOH na-enye Na+ 15 mmol, OH- 15 mmol. H+ 10 mmol na OH- 10 mmol na-emeghachi omume ma na-eji, ya mere OH- 5 mmol fọdụrụ. Ions = Na+ 15, Cl- 10, OH- 5 → ọnụọgụ 3 : 2 : 1, ngụkọta 30 mmol.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ngụkọta ions tupu a gwakọta = (10 + 10) + (15 + 15) = 50 mmol. Ọnụọgụ = 30/50 = 3/5.
Azịza: 3 : 2 : 1, 3/5 (a). (Azịza ezighi ezi: ịtụ OH- dị ka 15 kama 5 bụ ileghara neutralization anya, 5/3 bụ ọnụọgụ edere n'ụzọ nke ọzọ, 3/4 bụ ịgụ ngụkọta ions tupu a gwakọta dị ka 40 n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi)

chemistry-killer-05.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
